currentContext.expansion: Prima Plastics operates three manufacturing facilities in India (spanning three states and one union territory) and three international units, and states it 'continues to expand its operational footprint'. The AR describes expansion in distribution and product-portfolio terms rather than as named plant projects: 10 warehouses are currently operating at Coimbatore, Hubli, Jammu, Jaipur, Kanpur, Indore, Cuttack, Hyderabad, Vijayawada and Bangalore, with ongoing efforts to further expand warehousing capacity to serve new markets, alongside expansion of the PAN-India distributor and dealer network. Portfolio expansion during the year covered the Waste Management Division (launch of 60-litre, 80-litre and 110-litre bins complementing existing 660-litre and 1100-litre Wheeled Bins) and the Furniture Division (premium Event and Decorative Chairs, storage cabinets, and new SKUs for lifestyle segments). The only structural change with a dated milestone is the Scheme of Demerger: the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench order of 16 March 2026 became effective on 31 March 2026, transferring the rotational moulding business to Prima Innovation Limited. No named plant, line or capacity-addition project with a commissioning timeline is disclosed in the routed sections.
